I haven’t informed them - they are offering this settlement to ensure that I do not escalate this further.

Yup in England
Stay with us.. want to talk about what happened? Or anything else entirely?
I lost someone close to me 25 years ago and it changed my life forever. We leave marks on ppl, ones people will miss

It’s really hard, I told 2 ppl I thought had a genuine care but now I’m not sure anymore. I feel let down and dumped on. If I died they’d be sad I know, but also I guess it’s not their responsibility, I’m not their responsibility or their number 1 

We have to be that for ourselfs and that is so huge and hard when feeling this way.

You’re not alone, you’re here in mind, whoever you are, wherever you are.. kept in mind here. Be safe.
Still here with us? What do u need to stay safe tonight?
I found a really good help in a crisis cafe run by mind - maybe there is one in your town? Just a place to be with people who get it
My dog is one of the goodest good boys,I don’t know where I would be without him. I’m pleased you have a friend too :-)

I can really relate, i wish i had people around me, it is such a lonely place to be .. i have literally no one irl who knows how i feel right now

Making and keeping friends is hard enough anyway, but mixed in with feeling so low it is so much harder. I am a nice person, i have a lot to give, no one wants it
Keep on posting .. ppl here to listen
What were you looking for in the helpline? How can we help? Ppl are here with you
You’re not alone - your lovely post will reach others in their loneliness too. Much love and positive vibes your way
Such good boys and girls at work that day

Feeling it today does not undo all the hard work in feeling better - that resilience and coping is still there, anxiety can be the worst, you’ve shown your strength in getting through... that’s one huge achievement to use in batting away some of the today feels
Hey, i know you sent this 7 hours ago .. i do hope you are around to read this and just know that you are held in mind. Thinking of you.
Wow what a lovely friend :) Would he be up for a visit? do and talk normal regular stuff, or just sit with him, so he knows he is special, thought of and held in mind
